newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares leap 2.24 pct to new all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares leap 2.24 pct to new all-time high.

text.p: Istanbul shares jumped an average 2.24 percent in strong selective activity on Thursday, with the index hitting the week's fourth all-time high close in a row.
The IMKB-100 ended at a day's high of 90,740.86, up 1,991.87 points from Wednesday's previous record of 88,748.99. It gained 4.32 percent so far this week after last week's 5.38 percent surge.
Trade volume soared to 21.66 trillion lira ($212.6 million) from Wednesday's 17.93 trillion ($177.4 million).

The market had targeted the 90,000 barrier after overcoming stiff resistance at 85,000 last week. Brokers said some fresh cash inflow and year-end profit prospects of companies fuelled selective buys.
